scope: MODEL ESTIMATE. Selector between two lanes that both passed their hard gates. No organizer receipt.

instrument.name: sgmc_off_catalogue
instrument.definition: SGMC-derived fault cells with distance-to-catalogue > 3 px (62,122 in-footprint cells)
instrument.why: it is the only target in the repo that is independent of the label both lanes were selected against (QFaults), and 95.2% of it is absent from that catalogue
instrument.cross_check: a uniform 37,654-cell control scores 0.0789 here versus 0.0750 on the S3 lane's own implementation of the same instrument, so the two lanes are comparable

other_evidence.note: catalogue-based holdout; structurally biased for designs that avoid the catalogue

candidates.control_source: this lane, same budget, same seed, tilt 0

other_evidence.note: the fitted model is worse than the control; band 19 alone is not

rule: promote the candidate with the higher DTI on the shared independent instrument, among those that pass both hard gates; report both matched controls so a density effect cannot be mistaken for a design effect

verdict.caveat: A and B differ in budget as well as design. The nine-site density law fitted in this lane predicts a score of about 0.273 for ANY 37.6k design and 0.277 for B, so on the law the two are close; on the independent instrument B is 5.2x. B's downside is larger if the hidden truth is much smaller than 50k cells (at |G| = 25k its estimate falls to 0.176).
